summary: At the Maryland Recycling Network conference in Baltimore, recyclers focused on economic factors that could bring brighter days, such as improved commodity markets, new PET demand and upcoming EPR policies.

title: Waste CEO paychecks rose again in 2025. Here’s how much they made.
summary: Waste Dive’s eighth annual report analyzes compensation data for WM, Republic Services, Waste Connections, GFL Environmental, Clean Harbors, Enviri and Casella Waste Systems.

title: New Hampshire waste policy evolving with disposal fee, organics ban
summary: A new disposal surcharge generated more than $1 million during its first quarter for local reimbursements and grant funding. The recent NH Recycles conference featured updates on the state’s latest initiatives.

title: Maine becomes first state to enact EPR for vapes
summary: The law will establish more collection, recycling and disposal options for vape pens, which recycling industry groups say are a major cause of facility fires. A producer responsibility organization must now create collection infrastructure.

title: Braven Environmental no longer building chemical recycling plant in Texas
summary: The pyrolysis plant, planned for a Texarkana industrial park, received a boost from a state tax abatement program, but ultimately failed to gain traction.

title: California legislature advances key waste, recycling bills
summary: A hauler franchise bill, plus bills to manage medium-format batteries, vape waste, food donations and metal shredder facilities, are still in play. The state’s legislative session ends Aug. 31.

title: States grapple with billions in PFAS costs and ask EPA for assistance
summary: State regulators are waging a multi-pronged campaign to tackle PFAS contamination from industrial sources, but say funding from consent orders and existing EPA programs isn’t enough to address the scale of the challenge.

title: California advances compostables, recycled content labeling bills
summary: The legislation divided major recyclers, organics recyclers and trade groups over mass balance accounting, plastics in compost and more.
